prompted_for: Home section 'Service after handover': your change control, running cost, signed record; first prompt (blueprint style): exploded view of a pump with leader-line callouts to the three service promises
composition: wide panel on pale warm paper inside a drawing-sheet border with zone numbers 1-4 and letters A-D
uppercase headline top left, two lines
exploded pump assembly fills the centre, parts spread along a diagonal axis
three callouts: one left middle, two right (top and lower), each a heading plus two-line note
leader lines run from each callout to a specific part
title block bottom right with wordmark and drawing number
layout_devices: exploded view along a dashed axis
callout headings with small body text
palette: pale warm off-white / limestone paper ground
deep navy line work and type
mid steel-blue-grey leader and dimension lines
typography: light-weight uppercase sans headline with wide spacing
monospace body text for callout notes
tiny mono in title block and zone markers
line_and_texture: thinner grey-blue leaders and dimension lines
motifs: exploded centrifugal pump: housing, impeller, gaskets, O-rings, cover, fittings
ui_patterns: three feature callouts around one image
motion_implied: pump assembles then explodes along its axis on scroll
leader lines draw from part to callout
t2i_keywords: zone letters and numbers on border
t2i_prompt: A wide web page section drawn as an engineering drawing sheet on warm off-white paper, with a thin border carrying zone letters and numbers and a title block bottom right. A light uppercase sans-serif headline sits top left. In the centre, an isometric exploded-view line drawing in deep navy hairlines of <CONTENT>, parts spread along a dashed axis. Three callouts around it, each an uppercase heading with two lines of monospace text, connect to specific parts with thin steel-blue-grey leader lines. A few dimension arrows. Flat, no shading, generous negative space, no people.
signature_idea: Service promises pinned by leader lines to the actual parts of an exploded pump, as if the service plan were a parts drawing.
strengths: very legible: three promises, one object, clear leaders
monospace notes and title block feel like real documentation to QA readers
light paper and navy hairlines are close to the brand
exploded view is a natural scroll animation
weaknesses: uppercase headline departs from sentence-case brand voice
leaders point to arbitrary parts; the promises are not about those parts
pump looks like a cast-metal pump rather than a PP system component
no steel-blue highlight distinguishing a primary element
brand_fit_why: Calm, precise, square, navy on limestone with mono notes fits well; uppercase headings and arbitrary leader targets are off-brand details.
